info.description: Public API gateway for Gas Tam De customers and administrators.
info.title: Gas Tam De API

post.description: Supports IN, OUT, and ADJUST movements.

get.summary: List orders for the administrator desk

get.description: Returns a lightweight response when the public gateway is serving requests.

get.summary: Get the customer's latest order defaults

get.description: Returns products currently available to customers.

amount_paid.description:
AmountPaid is required for PARTIAL; optional for FULL (defaults to total)
and UNPAID (must be 0 or omitted).

customer_phone.description: Admin response — carries the callable number, like the other /v1/admin views.

CustomerPhone is the callable number; PhoneMasked is the fallback for
customers auth-service has no number on file for.

spent_vnd.description:
Money counts completed orders only — the same rule the rest of the system
follows: nothing is earned until the order is handed over.

unit_cost.description:
UnitCost is the COGS snapshot (VND giá nhập) taken when inventory
deducted this line. 0 = unknown (order placed before the field existed,
or the product has no cost price set in Kho).

completed_at.description:
Lifecycle timestamps + payment settlement, so a finished order can be
reopened and read back instead of vanishing from the desk.

customer_phone.description:
CustomerPhone is the full contact number. Only ever set by
[adminOrderView]: the shop has to be able to call the customer, while
customer-facing responses keep seeing phone_masked alone.

lat.description:
Lat/Lng are the delivery destination (WGS84) captured at place time —
used by admin navigation (US-5.2).

stt.description: Stt is 1-based FIFO desk sequence (admin list only; omitted for customer APIs).

name.description: required when creating stock on first IN

sku.description: required when creating stock on first IN

unit_cost.description: IN: required >= 0; ADJUST: optional cost update
